title: Shaam Chaliyan Ghazi Das Veeran
body:
Ghazi Day Tarlay Layndi Aj Malika Sharam Haya Di, Menu Chadar Veer Dawa Day.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Aun-o-Muhammad, Akbar Puttar Toh Waare Nay,
Udhay Jigar’ch Akhir Zalima Naizay Maaray Nay,
Main Rehgayi Sadqay Londee, Shabbir Day Nasal Bachaundi
Kala Bacheya Puttar Sajjad Ay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saab Shaam-e-Ghareeban Lung Gay Raat Ghuzar Gayi Ay,
Din Jhaar Gaya Veer Sakina Jag Dhi Raye Gayai,
Main Khakh Tay Rondee Jaway, Bus Mashak Nu Takdi Jaway,
Ainu Ahkay Ap Sawaday.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aik Maselay Tay Hal Karday Darda Waari Da,
Mainu Das Day Veeran Natlab Veer Bhagari Da,
Jeevain Larna Jang Akbar Nu, Ghazi Tu Wapp Sikaya,
Mainu Turna Veer Sikhaday.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jinay Lootiyan Da Jinay Maani Banri Kubra Da,
Jinay Saang Tay Haalray Baba Bhichri Sughra Da,
Mainu Ahkay Shaam De Rokha, Bhaina Tay Ghal Wich Rasiya,
Tu Zainab Ap Pawaday.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Zainab Dhi Surn Kay Ahu Zaari Nu,
Sir Naizay Pay Shabbir Day Duhkiyari Nu,
Chup Chap Tay Shaam Nu Turja, Abbas Nu Hoor Na Tarpa,
Na Zainab Bhain Sada Day.
